lesson.summary:
*have* dan *have got* sama-sama berarti "punya" atau "memiliki". Keduanya dipakai untuk barang, hubungan keluarga, penyakit, dan janji temu: *I've got a headache. She has two brothers. We've got a meeting at three.* *have got* lebih umum dalam bahasa lisan British.

Untuk kalimat tanya dan negatif, ada tiga bentuk:
*Do you have a car? / Have you got a car? / Have you a car?* (yang terakhir jarang dipakai).
*I don't have a car. / I haven't got a car.*
Jangan mencampur kedua pola: *Do you have got* salah.

Untuk masa lalu, pakai *had* tanpa *got*: *When I was a child, I had a bicycle. Did you have a phone then?*

*have* juga dipakai untuk aksi, seperti *have lunch, have a bath, have fun, have a look, have a rest*. Dalam pemakaian ini, *got* tidak boleh dipakai, dan bentuk continuous diperbolehkan: *We're having lunch. She has a shower every morning.*

patterns.formula: Do you have … ? / Have you got … ?

patterns.example: He doesn't have a car. / He hasn't got a car.
I had a bike when I was a child.

patterns.formula: have + breakfast / a shower / a good time (tanpa got)

examples.en: Have you got a pen I can borrow?
examples.id: Kamu punya pulpen yang bisa saya pinjam?

examples.en: She has got two brothers and a sister.
examples.id: Dia punya dua kakak laki-laki dan seorang adik perempuan.

examples.en: I've got a headache. Do you have any medicine?
examples.id: Kepala saya pusing. Kamu punya obat?

examples.en: Sorry, I can't come. I've got a dentist appointment at three.
examples.id: Maaf, saya tidak bisa datang. Saya ada janji dengan dokter gigi jam tiga.

examples.en: We usually have lunch at a warung near the office.
examples.id: Kami biasanya makan siang di warung dekat kantor.

examples.en: They had a great time at the party last night.
examples.id: Mereka bersenang-senang di pesta tadi malam.

commonMistakes.wrong: Do you have got a car?
commonMistakes.right: Do you have a car? / Have you got a car?

commonMistakes.wrong: We had got a great time at the party.
commonMistakes.right: We had a great time at the party.
commonMistakes.why: *have a good time* adalah aksi, jadi tidak memakai *got*.

commonMistakes.wrong: She has got a shower every morning.
commonMistakes.right: She has a shower every morning.
commonMistakes.why: Untuk aksi rutin (mandi, makan), pakai *have* saja.

options.why: Benar. Pertanyaan dengan have got: Have + subjek + got.
got tidak dipakai setelah do.
have dengan arti memiliki tidak dipakai dalam bentuk continuous.

questions.explanation: Have you got …? atau Do you have …?

questions.sentence: She ___ two brothers and a sister.

options.why: Benar. Subjek she: has got.
Subjek she membutuhkan has.
Memiliki saudara bukan aktivitas, jadi tidak memakai continuous.

questions.explanation: he/she/it + has got.

questions.sentence: We ___ breakfast at seven every day.

options.why: Benar. have breakfast adalah aksi, jadi tanpa got.
got tidak dipakai untuk aksi seperti makan atau mandi.
Bentuk ini tidak ada.

questions.explanation: have + breakfast/lunch/a shower (tanpa got).

questions.sentence: I ___ a headache. Do you have any medicine?

options.why: Benar. Sakit/penyakit: have got.
Bentuk ini tidak ada.
Urutannya salah.

questions.explanation: Penyakit: I have / I've got a headache, a cold, a fever.

options.why: Benar. Pertanyaan dengan have: Do you have …?
have dengan arti memiliki tidak dipakai dalam bentuk continuous.
Jangan mencampur do dengan have got.

questions.explanation: Do you have …? / Have you got …?

questions.sentence: When I was a child, I ___ a bicycle.

options.why: Benar. Masa lalu: had tanpa got.
Untuk kepemilikan di masa lalu, pakai had saja.
Kalimatnya tentang masa lalu.

questions.explanation: Lampau: had.

questions.sentence: They ___ a great time at the party last night.

options.why: Benar. have a good time adalah aksi, dan bentuk lampaunya had.
got tidak dipakai untuk aksi.
Kalimatnya tentang masa lalu, dan got tidak dipakai untuk aksi.

questions.explanation: have a good/great time → had a good/great time.

questions.sentence: Sorry, I can't come. I ___ a dentist appointment at three.

options.why: Benar. Janji temu: have got.
am tidak digabung dengan got.
Subjek I memakai have got, bukan has got.

questions.explanation: Janji temu: I've got / I have an appointment.
